channel.title: Coast Strong journal
channel.description: Practical Coast Strong guides for neighbors, students and teachers: find a way to help and make clear, safe reports.

item.title: Your first step for the coast
item.description: Find a useful way to help as a volunteer, student, teacher or neighbor with supplies, then coordinate the next step with the team.

item.title: A useful report starts with clear notes
item.description: Observe from safe, dry ground. Record what, where and when, add a photo only from a safe distance, and use official reporting channels.
